clips.title: The story
paras: Baron Revilgaz has the Fuel Regulator Blueprints ready and sends them to Pozzik on the Shimmering Flats. He gives his regards and adds that Pozzik should not hesitate to ask if he ever needs anything.

Baron Revilgaz says you are all set. You carry the blueprints to Pozzik, out on the Shimmering Flats, with the Baron's regards and a message: if Pozzik ever needs anything, he should not hesitate to ask. Revilgaz says he will be waiting for news that Pozzik breaks the track record.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You should be all set to go. Give Pozzik my regards and tell him that if he ever needs anything, not to hesitate to ask. I'll be waiting for the news that he breaks the track record soon!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend! Did you manage to track down the fuel regulator?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I was hoping that it would be already assembled, but this does present the unique opportunity to improve on the design from the ground up. Thanks, friend. I'll be able to sketch up some improved schematics, build the thing, and have it installed real soon.
